basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 11 Superintending Engineer, Senior Analyst and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Patna is filling ten Group A designations on deputation, eleven posts in all when the row-wise figures are added, since Senior Dietician carries two. The notice is addressed to serving officers of Central, State and UT Governments, universities, statutory and autonomous bodies, PSUs, research organisations and, where the post allows, the armed and paramilitary forces; it is not a direct-recruitment notice and the public cannot apply. how_to_apply: Fill in the Annexure-I proforma printed with the notice (23 columns: name, father's name, date of birth, e-mail, dates of entry into service and retirement, educational qualifications, essential and desirable qualifications and experience as advertised against those possessed, employment record in chronological order with the pay band and grade pay of each post held on a regular basis, nature of present employment, details of any current or past deputation, whether you are in the feeder grade of the same department, pay-scale details, total monthly emoluments, additional information and achievements, SC/ST/OBC status, contact numbers, minimum joining time), with a passport-size photograph and a signed declaration.

Enclose, on your side: your latest salary slip (column 17 of the form; checklist item 7). Applicants not on Central Government pay scales attach the salary slip showing basic pay, scale, rate of increment, dearness pay or interim relief and allowances with break-up (column 18); a short note of one page, about 100 words, on the areas of your experience that would benefit AIIMS Patna (column 23 of the form; checklist item 6). Only the pay band and grade pay of the post held on a regular basis are to be entered in the employment table; pay granted under ACP or MACP is personal and is shown separately in the table provided for it.

Route the application through proper channel. The forwarding office verifies the particulars and eligibility and encloses: duly attested photocopies of the applicant's Confidential Reports or APARs for at least the latest five years, attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India or above; vigilance clearance strictly in the Annexure-II format, certifying that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated; clearance in any other format, or with conditions, is rejected; in the same Annexure-II: certification that the particulars are true, that the applicant holds the advertised qualifications and experience, that he or she will be relieved immediately if selected, and that integrity is certified; also in Annexure-II, a penalty declaration: either that no major or minor penalty has been imposed on the applicant during the last 10 years, or a list of the major and minor penalties imposed during the last 10 years; the pay-scale comparative chart certified by the Finance or Accounts department, where the parent organisation does not follow Central pay scales. Officers who are already on deputation must have their applications forwarded by the parent cadre or department, with cadre clearance, vigilance clearance and integrity certificate (Note 1 under column 11).

content_sections.heading: Posts, Pay Level and Vacancies
content_sections.text: The number of posts is tentative and may change with the Institute's requirement. No category-wise reservation is printed, as is usual for deputation.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Eligibility
content_sections.text: Service: employees of Central/State/UT Governments, universities, Central statutory or autonomous bodies, PSUs or R&D organisations holding an analogous post; or Executive Engineers with 5 years' regular service in Grade Pay Rs. 7,600; or Executive Engineers with 10 years' regular service in Grade Pay Rs. 6,600. Essential qualification: graduate in Civil Engineering from a recognised university or institute. The notice sets two conditions, (i) and (ii), both to be met. (i) Service: officers under Central/State/UT Governments, universities, statutory or autonomous bodies or R&D organisations "holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with at least 5 years of regular service in the grade pay of Rs. 7,600, or with at least 5 years of regular service in the grade pay of Rs. 6,600" (as printed; the notice gives the same five years for both grade pays, whereas the Superintending Engineer row gives 5 and 10 years; applicants in Grade Pay 6,600 should confirm the requirement with AIIMS Patna before applying). (ii) Essential qualification: (a) Master's degree in Science, preferably in Biological Sciences, of a recognised university or equivalent; and (b) degree or equivalent diploma in Library Science of a recognised institution or university. Desirable: Master's degree in Library Science; training in medical librarianship. Service: officers from Ministries or Departments of the Government of India, State Governments, Union Territories, statutory or autonomous bodies holding an analogous post on a regular basis, or a post with Grade Pay Rs. 6,600 and above with 5 years' regular service in that grade. Essential qualification: M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science or Computer Engineering, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, plus 15 years' experience in IT systems, networking, hardware configuration or software programming in Ministries or Departments of the Government of India, State Governments, Union Territories, or statutory or autonomous bodies. Service and qualification: Architects, or officers in an equivalent grade, in CPWD holding a degree in Architecture with not less than 5 years' experience in the line. If suitable CPWD officers are not available, similar officers from other Central Government departments, Central autonomous or statutory bodies or PSUs may be considered. Service: officers under Central/State Governments, UT administrations or Central statutory or autonomous bodies holding an analogous post, or with at least 5 years' regular service in a post with Grade Pay Rs. 5,400. Experience: 5 years as a Stores Officer on a regular basis. Service: employees of Central/State/UT Governments, universities, statutory or autonomous bodies, PSUs or R&D organisations holding an analogous post on a regular basis, or with 5 years' regular service in a post with Grade Pay Rs. 5,400. Qualification and experience: M.A. in Social Work or MSW from a recognised institute or university, and not less than 5 years' experience in medical social welfare with sound knowle

content_sections.heading: Age, Tenure and General Conditions
content_sections.text: Age: maximum 56 years as on the last date of posting of the application. Tenure: three years, extendable to a maximum of five years under DoPT guidelines; governed by DoPT O.M. No. 2/6/2018-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 18 May 2018, as amended. Eligibility is regulated by the relevant Recruitment Rules and DoPT instructions. Only post-qualification experience counts, and the Competent Authority's view on relevance of experience is final. Pay-scale comparison: applicants not on Central Government pay scales must enclose a comparative chart of their scale against the Central scale, certified by their Finance or Accounts department. Exclusion: AIIMS Patna employees in the direct line of promotion for an advertised post may not apply for it.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026 is an official notification inviting applications to fill 11 deputation vacancies across various administrative and technical posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies announced for various posts under this deputation notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of completed applications is 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying for the posts on deputation is 56 years as on the last date of posting of application.

faq.question: Q5. How should applications be submitted for AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline through proper channel via Speed Post or Registered Post to the Recruitment Cell, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Phulwarisharif, Patna- 801507.
